desc: Introducing the Keystone Crickett Mini Springfield 1903 Rifle – a classic .22LR caliber rifle that pays homage to the iconic Springfield 1903, tailored specifically for youth shooters. The rifle features a beautiful wood stock made from walnut, giving it a traditional feel and sturdy grip. The metal parts are finished in blued steel, ensuring durability and resistance to the elements. This rifle boasts an 18-inch barrel and an overall length of 31 inches, making it the perfect size for younger enthusiasts.
